notes: Tasks is the one due list: with Projects on, open project reminders sit among the dated tasks, due first, and the Tasks badge and the app icon count both.

Settings → Notifications & voice: choose which notifications this device gets (finished turns, due tasks and reminders, Vault requests), the count on the app icon, a notice a day before, and an email address for due items when the server has POCKET_SMTP_URL.
A due notification offers Tomorrow (and Done for a task); Remind later on a task picks a new time.
